    Bug 1977953 - Fix ical.js vendoring. r=jtracey
    This was broken by a change in the build system upstream. I'm not including an actual update of
    the library yet as there's some a bug we want to fix first.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D257792

diff --git a/third_party/icaljs/moz.yaml b/third_party/icaljs/moz.yaml
index 47bce642a85..e04de773e6c 100644
--- a/third_party/icaljs/moz.yaml
+++ b/third_party/icaljs/moz.yaml
@@ -65,6 +65,7 @@ vendoring:
     - package-lock.json
     - package.json
     - rollup.config.js
+    - tsconfig.json
 
   keep:
     - make_bundle.sh
@@ -101,3 +102,6 @@ vendoring:
 
     - action: delete-path
       path: 'rollup.config.js'
+
+    - action: delete-path
+      path: 'tsconfig.json'
